tagline: Sunset is a press release. Ghosts are a runtime.

exhibits.title: Stadia
exhibits.obituaryNote: Official goodbye: “Stadia service is no longer available. Thanks for playing.”
exhibits.note: The product is dead. The hostname still serves a 200 with the funeral already printed on the page. That is a ghost, not a 410.

exhibits.title: Google Domains
exhibits.obituaryNote: Google announced sale of domain registrations to Squarespace.
exhibits.note: The registrar was sold. The original lockup still answers on domains.google — a storefront for a product Google no longer operates.

exhibits.title: Vine
exhibits.obituaryNote: Twitter discontinued the Vine mobile apps in 2016–2017.
exhibits.note: The six-second network was killed. vine.co still returns 200 and still calls itself Vine. Do not build on it.

exhibits.title: SWFObject on Google Hosted Libraries
exhibits.obituaryNote: Adobe ended Flash Player distribution December 31, 2020.
exhibits.note: The runtime had a funeral. The loader script that embedded .swf files is still a 200 on a public CDN. A door to a room that was demolished.

exhibits.title: Azure AD Graph
exhibits.obituaryNote: Microsoft documented Azure AD Graph retirement (extended access ended 2025).
exhibits.note: Retired APIs should go 410. This host still speaks Azure AD Graph JSON: 401 invalid_token, odata.error. The door is locked. It is not gone.

exhibits.title: Mixer
exhibits.obituaryNote: Microsoft shut Mixer down in July 2020.
exhibits.note: mixer.com 301s into Facebook Gaming. The name on the door is Mixer. The room is someone else’s product.

exhibits.title: Atom
exhibits.note: atom.io still answers — by walking you to its own obituary. A polite ghost.

exhibits.title: Parse.com API
exhibits.obituaryNote: Parse hosted service shut down January 28, 2017. Open-source Parse Server remains.
exhibits.note: Contrast hanging. Parse returns 410 with a pointer to the open-source funeral home. This is what a completed sunset looks like.
